statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The denial reason is that the service does not meet criteria for medical necessity
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data
The monitoring is essential to evaluate clinical significance and guide appropriate management
